sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant is the husband of the deceased and marriage of deceased was solemnized with applicant on 16.04.2022 and after sometime, she left her in-laws house and started living with her parents
, thereafter, on 11.04.2024 at about 5:00 PM, she committed suicide in her parents house.

He next submitted that earlier deceased has also lodged a first information report against her in-laws being Case Crime No. 275 of 2023, under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506, 376 IPC, Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 67-A of Information Technology Act and the said matter was compromised between applicant and deceased as they decided to live separately and amount as agreed in terms of compromise entered into between the parties, has also been given to the deceased.
He next submitted that applicant was not in contact with the deceased since last two years and she was living with her parents.
Applicant has been implicated in the present case being husband of the deceased.
Applicant has neither instigated nor committed any atrocities upon the deceased to commit suicide.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 25.04.2024 having no criminal history.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.

4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the bail prayer of the applicant and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and deceased has died within seven years of her marriage, as such, offence against the applicant is made out.
5.

Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Akshay Sharma, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.

(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/
pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Order Date :- 14.8.2024
